```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in":   (16.0, 12.0, 20.0),
    "L_in":      (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "itail":     (8e-6, 5e-6, 12e-6),
    "i2":        (20e-6, 12e-6, 26e-6),
    "cc":        (16e-12, 8e-12, 24e-12),
    "gmid_ld":   (12.0, 8.0, 14.0),
    "L_ld":      (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),
    "gmid_ns":   (14.0, 10.0, 16.0),
    "rz_fac":    (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    Ln = 2.0
    it, i2, cc = p["itail"], p["i2"], p["cc"]

    # bias: ibias diode, tail and stage-2 sink mirrors (same gm/Id, L)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_ns"], Ln, iref, vds=None or 0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmid_ns"], Ln, iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_ns"], Ln, it, vds=0.2)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_ns"], Ln, i2, vds=0.9)
    # input pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], it / 2, vds=0.45, vsb=0.15)
    # PMOS mirror load and CS second stage (same gm/Id, L -> current ratio by W)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], it / 2, vds=0.9)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], it / 2, vds=m3.vgs)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_ld"], p["L_ld"], i2, vds=0.9)

    rz = p["rz_fac"] / m6.gm * (1 + cl / cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "x1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)   # diode side driven by vinn
    n.dev("M2", "x2", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)   # output side driven by vinp
    n.dev("M3", "x1", "x1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x2", "x1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # vinp up -> x2 down -> M6 (PMOS CS) pulls vout up : non-inverting from vinp
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "x2", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "x2", "xz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "xz", "vout", cc)

    # predictions
    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    c1 = m6.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * cc / (c1 * cl + cc * (c1 + cl)) / (2 * PI)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2))
    slew = min(it / cc, i2 / (cl + cc))
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 * tau
    power = (iref + it + i2) * vdd
    cmrr = db(2 * gm1 * m3.gm / (mt.gds * (m1.gds + m3.gds)) / 2)
    kT4 = 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300
    noise_th = math.sqrt(2 * kT4 * 0.8 / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise = noise_th * 8  # crude flicker allowance at 1 kHz
    swing = vdd - m6.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.3

    return n, {"gain_db": gain, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "settle": settle, "power": power, "cmrr_db": cmrr,
               "psrr_db": gain + 3, "noise_1k": noise, "swing": swing}
```
